subject: Acme redlines received + Redwood next steps (MAP legal milestone)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Lal <priya.lal@acmemap.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft & next steps (MSA/DPA/SLA redlines)

Hi Priya / Alex -

Thanks again for the call this morning - great alignment on the product fit and deployment timeline. Per our discussion I'm attaching the current MAP draft and summarizing the legal milestone so we're all clear on owners and turnaround expectations.

MAP legal milestone (proposed):
- Deliverable: MSA redlines + comments (Acme) -> Redwood legal reviews and issues counters -> finalize MSA/DPA/SLA
- Target close date: 2026-07-15 (aligned to your FY close and Redwood provisioning window)
- Owners:
  - Acme: provide initial MSA redlines and any specific procurement language (deadline proposed: 2026-07-06)
  - Redwood Legal (Neha): lead review and produce counters; own DPA/SLA edits
  - Redwood Engineering/Infra (Dev): provide SOC2 evidence, retention details, and SRE contact for technical Qs
- Turnaround times (proposed):
  - Redwood legal: 48-72 hours after receiving redlines for an initial counter
  - Acme legal: 48-72 hours after counters for any follow-up
- Dependencies: signed PO/procurement terms, SOC2 report (or SOC2 in progress evidence), IP/usage limits for SLA metrics

Next steps I propose:
1) Priya/Alex - send MSA redlines file by COB Mon 7/6 (attachment stub OK).
2) Neha - confirm you can review and commit to the 48-72h counter target once we receive redlines.
3) Dev - gather SOC2/technical artifacts and share links to the security pack.

If that looks good I'll update the MAP milestones in the shared Drive and add the dates.

Thanks -
Marissa

From: Priya Lal <priya.lal@acmemap.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmemap.com>, Baker & Co Legal <legal@bakerco.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft & next steps (MSA/DPA/SLA redlines)

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. We'll get you the MSA redlines (ACME internal) by EOD Monday 7/6. I've looped in our external counsel (Baker & Co) who will produce the annotated MSA; attaching the doc we expect to send (ACME_MAP_MSA_v3_redlines.docx).

On turnaround - Acme aims for 48 hours for initial review of counters, so your proposed 48-72h for Redwood is fine. A couple notes:
- Procurement asks for a standard PO template; I'll follow up with our procurement lead in a separate email.
- We'll also need a short SLA appendix showing uptime and latency SLOs for the dedicated pool (can Dev provide a one-pager?).

Appreciate marking Neha as the Redwood legal owner. If Baker & Co needs anything from Redwood legal directly we're happy to set a call.

Best,
Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Internal - forwarding Acme's note and the MSA redlines they'll send Monday. Quick asks:

Neha - can you confirm you'll own the MSA review and counters? Recommend we aim for an initial counter within 24-48h after we receive their redlines to keep to the 7/15 target. Please call out any clauses you expect to escalate to GC.

Dev - can you prepare the SLA one-pager (uptime, latency SLOs for dedicated pool), SOC2 evidence links, and the SRE contact who can join any technical calls? If possible share by Mon 7/6 so I can attach to the MAP.

Thanks -

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: MAP draft & next steps (MSA/DPA/SLA redlines)

Marissa / team -

I'll take the lead on the MSA and will allocate bandwidth to review Acme's redlines as soon as they land. Plan below:
- Initial triage and commentary (high-level flags) within 24 hours of receiving the redlines.
- Full counterparty redline draft within 48 hours in most cases. If there are GC-level escalations I'll flag and propose a short call; that may add 24-48 hours depending on schedule.
- I'll draft DPA/SLA language where needed; if Acme has specific data residency or KMS requirements we'll loop infra.

I've attached a short checklist I'll use to accelerate review: key clauses (indemnity, liability cap, data use, retention, breach notification, audit) and escalation triggers.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Lal <priya.lal@acmemap.com>

Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmemap.com>, Baker & Co Legal <legal@bakerco.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MSA redlines (attached)

Marissa / Neha -

Please find attached our annotated MSA (ACME_MAP_MSA_v3_redlines.docx). Baker & Co prepared comments on indemnity, liability cap, IP/usage, and data processing sections. A few items to highlight up front:
- Acme requests a mutual indemnity for third-party data claims and a liability cap equal to fees for 12 months.
- We propose SLA appendix language referencing uptime target of 99.9% for the dedicated pool and a schedule of credits tied to latency percentiles.
- Procurement will also send a standard PO template and may request a two-step acceptance criteria for go-live.

We're available on a short call if Redwood legal prefers to triage clause-level items live.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Lal <priya.lal@acmemap.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood initial counter and next steps

Priya / team -

Thanks for sending the redlines. Neha has completed an initial triage and we've produced an initial counterparty redline (Redwood_initial_counter_20260706.docx) focusing on indemnity, liability cap, and data processing. Summary of next steps and owners so we keep the MAP on track:
- Neha (Redwood Legal): finalize and send formal counter within 48 hours if no GC escalations; propose a 30-day liability cap tied to fees unless Acme provides revenue-based justification.
- Dev (Infra): attaching SLA one-pager and SOC2 link in a follow-up (will share within 2 hours).
- Acme/Baker & Co: review Redwood counter and propose call windows for Thu 7/8 if needed.
- Procurement/Finance (Rishi): standing by for PO template and pricing exception requests.

If everyone is aligned we'll aim to close the MSA and DPA by 2026-07-15 per the MAP.

Best,
Marissa
